nodes.Name: Record
nodes.DocComment:
A Record holds information about a log event.
Copies of a Record share state.
Do not modify a Record after handing out a copy to it.
Call [NewRecord] to create a new Record.
Use [Record.Clone] to create a copy with no shared state.

nodes.Name: NewRecord
nodes.DocComment:
NewRecord creates a [Record] from the given arguments.
Use [Record.AddAttrs] to add attributes to the Record.

NewRecord is intended for logging APIs that want to support a [Handler] as
a backend.

nodes.Name: Clone
nodes.DocComment:
Clone returns a copy of the record with no shared state.
The original record and the clone can both be modified
without interfering with each other.

nodes.Name: NumAttrs
nodes.DocComment: NumAttrs returns the number of attributes in the [Record].

nodes.Name: Attrs
nodes.DocComment:
Attrs calls f on each Attr in the [Record].
Iteration stops if f returns false.

nodes.Name: AddAttrs
nodes.DocComment:
AddAttrs appends the given Attrs to the [Record]'s list of Attrs.
It omits empty groups.

nodes.Name: Add
nodes.DocComment:
Add converts the args to Attrs as described in [Logger.Log],
then appends the Attrs to the [Record]'s list of Attrs.
It omits empty groups.

nodes.Name: countAttrs
nodes.DocComment: countAttrs returns the number of Attrs that would be created from args.

nodes.Name: argsToAttr
nodes.DocComment:
argsToAttr turns a prefix of the nonempty args slice into an Attr
and returns the unconsumed portion of the slice.
If args[0] is an Attr, it returns it.
If args[0] is a string, it treats the first two elements as
a key-value pair.
Otherwise, it treats args[0] as a value with a missing key.

nodes.Name: Source
nodes.DocComment: Source describes the location of a line of source code.

nodes.Name: group
nodes.DocComment:
group returns the non-zero fields of s as a slice of attrs.
It is similar to a LogValue method, but we don't want Source
to implement LogValuer because it would be resolved before
the ReplaceAttr function was called.

nodes.Name: isEmpty
nodes.DocComment: isEmpty returns whether the Source struct is nil or only contains zero fields.

nodes.Name: Source
nodes.DocComment:
Source returns a new Source for the log event using r's PC.
If the PC field is zero, meaning the Record was created without the necessary information
or the location is unavailable, then nil is returned.
